scope: Integrate the qualified closed target data into typed exact-plan validation. Do not add runtime policy permissions, target selectors, adapters or actions before their separate complete contracts.

changes.types: Import and re-export only the two qualified target types; include both in ResourceTarget. Keep ResourceTargetSelector unchanged: no new bounded-batch branch.
changes.malformedTarget: For either new kind, use its complete qualified pure validator before any generic id.trim or payload access. Valid exact targets produce no shape errors; invalid new targets produce a deterministic nonempty shape error, never a method-call exception. Existing four-kind behavior remains unchanged.
changes.resourceIdentity: Proof identity fixes repository/worktree/proof_path, independent of approval and digest witness. Host identity fixes repository/worktree/operation plus approval_id if present and phase if consume-phase. Invalid new shapes yield a safe fixed invalid identity without interpolating their untrusted fields.
changes.matchesSelector: New kinds always return false. No bounded selector may admit either target, including a caller-forged new selector or a generic fs/Git/DB/remote selector.
changes.resourceValid: Use the qualified pure validators for the two new kinds. A valid shape is a valid query input, not policy permission. Existing policy selectors still cannot match either kind.
changes.authority: No new classification or domain dispatch is implemented in this step. classifyAuthorityResource must still refuse these targets; no prepared host/index capability or applied=true result can follow from this data integration. Do not add a classifier branch until the real final adapter contract and dispatch are implemented together.

independent_tests: Actual malformedPlan exact new targets pass shape validation with existing valid envelope, while malformed fields and extra physical paths fail without throwing or mutating input.
Logical resource duplicates remain duplicates even if digest or approval witnesses differ. Distinct worktrees and exact host operations remain distinct, with no widened filesystem identity.
All new-kind bounded batches and forged/generic selectors are refused; exact policy selector attempts still cannot match.
Actual resourceValid accepts only the qualified shapes and refuses unknown keys/physical paths. Shape acceptance remains distinct from actual classifier refusal and policy denial.
Unchanged original decision contracts and policy resolver tests retain their meanings. No registry, schema, adapter, CLI or authority function-barrel export changes.
remaining: Close exact policy selectors and bound permission compiler with schema consumers
Close real final adapter capture/apply, admission and operation-handle custody
Integrate classification and dispatch atomically with actual adapter availability and safe refusal
All public B1 workflows and release qualification
